changelog:
## Aura Cascade Reimagined 0.2.1 Beta

Visual-feedback hotfix for Minecraft 1.21.1 / Fabric. Requires Java 21, Fabric Loader 0.19.1+, Fabric API and Patchouli 1.21.1-93-FABRIC. Energy API is bundled. Back up existing worlds before upgrading.

- Adds visible particles to dropped-item crafting, including Angel's Steel ground combinations and machine outputs.
- Briefly previews available connections when placing aura-network blocks, even before adding crystals.
- Selects the Aura creative inventory tab on the first opening per client session, while preserving subsequent tab choices.
- Keeps observed aura-color HUD rows visible at actual zero values during transfers and prevents nearby entity targeting from hiding block inspection.
- Separates all nine Encyclopedia opening links onto individual rows.
- Updates the display name and homepage to Aura Cascade Reimagined. Existing registry IDs remain unchanged.

Unofficial modern port of Aura Cascade by pixlepix; original 1.8.x port by williewillus. Original texture credits and MIT notices are retained.
